title: Miitopia
shortDescription: Miitopia helps define a Nintendo 3DS family simulation path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Offers a clearly labeled simulation route through the Nintendo 3DS family collection.
Separates the GameAtlas catalog method from the external factual reference.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Registered for the Nintendo 3DS family simulation discovery path using the documented Wikidata platform mapping; this remains a catalog-method note with no imported numerical signal.
